body.statement: If \(\mathcal C_P\neq\varnothing\), then \(\mathcal C_P\) is compact and convex in \(C(X_0)\), the extrema \(V_P^-\) and \(V_P^+\) are attained, and \(\Theta(P)=[(T-V_P^+)/A,(T-V_P^-)/A]\subseteq[-K,K]\).
body.justification: Attainment turns an abstract image into reportable sharp endpoints and rules out closure-only bounds.
body.gap: Finite-support shape-restriction results attain LP endpoints, but the present feasible object is a continuous function constrained by support-local cones.
body.consumer: Endpoint attainment supplies explicit least-favorable causal completions for robustness reporting and specification diagnostics.
